verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's event subscriptions publish account events to a Queue, which is consumed by Workers or HTTP pull consumers. That is a pull/queue model, not registrable outbound HTTP callbacks pushed to a subscriber URL. The Agents SDK mention of connecting webhooks describes inbound webhooks into an agent runtime, not outbound event delivery, so it is adjacent rather than the webhook-subscription capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Cloudflare products (e.g., KV, Workers AI, Workers) can publish structured events to a queue, which you can then consume with Workers or HTTP pull consumers to build custom workflows, integrations, or logic
